title: Rakshasa skull ritual
summary: Roshawna’s skull ritual summons a courier and a group of reanimated Vah Shir.
overview: Roshawna’s skull ritual summons a courier and a group of reanimated Vah Shir.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Complete the ritual hand-in only when your group is prepared. The sequence creates a courier and eight reanimated Vah Shir.
Control the supporting undead while completing the ritual’s combat objective.
Return to the quest giver after the fight to finish the requested collection and hand-in steps.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
